'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals''' was a Players Committee regional, 6 February 2011, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2011 Luxembourg Regionals.pdf]]). Some sheets say the deck is the same as the day before; those lists come from the player's [[2011 Belgium Regionals]] sheet.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Site:''' Luxembourg
* '''Dates:''' 6 February 2011
* '''Winner:''' —
